envelope.description: Own Vibe turn dispatch, events and cleanup

body.title: Own Vibe turn dispatch, events and cleanup
body.summary: Extend the verified session path with bounded turn dispatch and events. Track not-sent, possibly-sent and accepted states before writes and preserve them through loss, timeouts, cancellation and child cleanup. Preserve text, reasoning, tool events, native identity and terminal outcome for both adapters.
acceptanceChecks: The verified session submits turn/start once
Lost acknowledgement and accepted failures preserve dispatch certainty
Cancellation closes the owned turn and child and keeps partial output and identity

tests.name: Scripted Vibe turn acknowledgement loss, bounded events, cancellation and cleanup
